answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow blocks bulk fakes. A new agent deposits 80 POA for 20 epochs, building a fingerprint from tasks and counterparties. Work unlocks it, like nectar gathered slowly. A forger with 1,000 copies faces a spiral: each needs 20 epochs of distinct history, or its deposit burns. That is 80,000 POA locked plus 20,000 epochs of work, no discount. An honest agent pays once, reaches the mesa of trust, and keeps earnings undiluted.
